name: PostOnce
description: PostOnce is a social media automation platform that enables creators, teams, and businesses to schedule and crosspost content across platforms including TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook, LinkedIn, X, Threads, Bluesky, and Pinterest.

events.d: Generate a signed upload URL for a media file by filename; MIME type is auto-detected from the filename extension.
Retrieve a media item's storage path and public URL using its media ID.
Create a post to selected accounts with content, media, scheduling, and platform-specific options.
Retrieve posts or a single post by ID. Leave fields empty to return all data; set limit (1, 100) and after cursor.
Cancel a scheduled or pending post by Post ID without deleting its record or published content.
Publish a scheduled or draft Postonce post immediately by specifying the post ID.
Retrieve drafts or a specific draft by ID. Choose mode and set draft_id, status, limit, after, or after_id.
Runs when a new post is created. You can filter by account and set the lookback minutes.
Create a workflow to crosspost from one source to multiple targets; set name, filters, intervals, and publish options.
Retrieve all workflows or a specific workflow by ID; optionally select which fields to return.
List all accounts or search by account ID or username; optionally return selected fields.
